unit: Unit XVI — Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers
title: Industrial Alcohols: Methanol Toxicity & Denatured Ethanol
topics: Methanol (CH₃OH, 'Wood Spirit') Catalytic Synthesis: CO + 2H₂ ──[ZnO-Cr₂O₃, 200–300 atm, 573–673 K]──► CH₃OH
Biochemical Toxicity Mechanism: Liver Alcohol Dehydrogenase converts Methanol ──► Formaldehyde (HCHO) + Formic Acid (HCOOH)
Pathology: Protein Coagulation, Irreversible Optic Nerve Destruction (Blindness), Acidosis & Death
Toxicity Antidote: Intravenous Ethanol (Competitive Inhibitor for Alcohol Dehydrogenase)
Denatured Alcohol Formulation: Ethanol + 5% Methanol + Pyridine (foul odor) + CuSO₄ (blue color)
quickSummary: Methanol ('Wood Spirit') is made by catalytic hydrogenation of CO. Ingested methanol oxidizes in the liver via alcohol dehydrogenase into Formaldehyde and Formic Acid, causing optic nerve damage, blindness, and death. Antidote is intravenous Ethanol (competitive inhibitor). Denatured alcohol is ethanol rendered toxic with methanol, pyridine, and copper sulfate.
summary: Master industrial alcohol manufacturing, methanol enzymatic toxicity mechanisms, and denatured ethanol formulations.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
METHANOL SYNTHESIS & ENZYMATIC TOXICITY:

• Synthesis: CO(g) + 2H₂(g) ──[ZnO-Cr₂O₃, 200–300 atm, 573–673 K]──► CH₃OH(l)
• Toxicity:  CH₃OH ──[Alcohol Dehydrogenase]──► HCHO (Formaldehyde) ──► HCOOH (Formic Acid)
• Pathology: Coagulates retinal proteins ──► Blindness; Acidosis ──► Respiratory arrest & death.
• Antidote:  Intravenous Ethanol (Competitively binds alcohol dehydrogenase).
conceptBreakdown.content:
Methanol ($\text{CH}_3\text{OH}$ - "Wood Spirit") is produced by high-pressure catalytic hydrogenation of $\text{CO}$.
- **Biochemical Toxicity**: Ingested methanol is oxidized in the liver by Alcohol Dehydrogenase into Formaldehyde ($\text{HCHO}$) and Formic Acid ($\text{HCOOH}$), coagulating proteins and destroying the optic nerve.
- **Antidote**: Intravenous administration of Ethanol (competes for the enzyme, allowing kidneys to excrete intact methanol).

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
DENATURED ALCOHOL COMPOSITION:

• Commercial Ethanol rendered undrinkable by adding:
  1. 5% Methanol (toxic wood spirit)
  2. Pyridine (imparts repulsive foul odor)
  3. Copper Sulfate (imparts diagnostic blue color)
conceptBreakdown.content: Denatured alcohol is commercial ethanol rendered unfit for human consumption by adding toxic and foul-smelling additives.

quickRevision: Methanol is made from CO + 2H₂ over ZnO-Cr₂O₃ catalyst.
Methanol is metabolized to Formaldehyde and Formic Acid in the liver.
Causes protein coagulation, optic nerve damage (blindness), and death.
Ethanol is the competitive antidote for methanol poisoning.
Denatured alcohol contains ethanol + methanol + pyridine + CuSO₄.
